signature.composition: tag between caliper jaws with B to right

prompt: One SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on pure white showing tag buffer size. At center place a large dark-blue tag with a clear hole, held between two thick orange caliper jaws from above and below, forming a recognizable simple C-shaped measuring tool. Put a large black B to the right for bytes. Only three bold simple shapes; no scale ticks, no weights, no other writing, no shadow. Keep B's two holes open, generous white margins.
